description: Source code for a Runtime class managing debugging, console message handling, and execution contexts in Firefox's developer tools, including worker environment support.

classes.name: Runtime
classes.description: Manages debugging, console message listening, execution contexts, and communication with the debugger in Firefox.

classes.name: ExecutionContext
classes.description: Represents an execution context within the Runtime, providing methods for evaluating scripts and functions, managing remote objects, and handling bindings.

methods.name: executionContexts
methods.description: Returns an array of current execution contexts.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates an expression in a specified execution context.

methods.name: callFunction
methods.description: Calls a function in a specified execution context.

methods.name: getObjectProperties
methods.description: Retrieves properties of an object in a given execution context.

methods.name: disposeObject
methods.description: Disposes of a remote object by ID.

methods.name: _registerConsoleServiceListener
methods.description: Registers a listener for console messages via Services.

methods.name: _registerConsoleAPIListener
methods.description: Registers a listener for console API messages.

methods.name: _registerWorkerConsoleHandler
methods.description: Sets up console message handling for worker environments.

methods.name: _onConsoleMessage
methods.description: Handles console messages and emits corresponding events.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Removes all event listeners and cleans up.

methods.name: _awaitPromise
methods.description: Waits for a promise object to settle and returns the result.

methods.name: createExecutionContext
methods.description: Creates and registers a new execution context.

methods.name: findExecutionContext
methods.description: Finds an execution context by ID.

methods.name: destroyExecutionContext
methods.description: Removes an execution context and cleans up associated data.
